headline: 克魯斯主演生態諷刺片影評
context: 這是衛報影評人對新片《Digger》的評論。片中湯姆克魯斯（Tom Cruise）飾演一名口無遮攔的石油大亨，一人不負責任的鑽探行為引爆全球危機。這部片出自奧斯卡得主導演伊納利圖（Alejandro González Iñárritu），但影評人形容全片顯得吃力，又有點過度自我陶醉。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: One man’s irresponsible drilling causes a global crisis in Iñárritu’s exasperatingly laborious, self-congratulatory film A new movie from the Oscar-winning Mexican director Alejandro González Iñárritu is always an event. So it’s disconcerting to discover that the event in question is the most disappointing film of the year: an exasperatingly shallow, laborious, self-congratulatory satire with a trick up its sleeve, featuring very good actors giving not very good performances. There are moments to enjoy in Tom Cruise’s boisterous leading turn, yes, but the film’s value resides chiefly in some dreamlike and disturbing images, distorted and bulging from the screen, conjured by cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki and production designer Dennis Gassner. An ageing, paunchy Texan oil tycoon called “Digger” Rockwell is seen fretfully getting up in the morning, cooing over his horrible old incontinent cat, taking urgent messages from underlings about a certain situation developing in his drilling station in the frozen Arctic. He is played by Tom Cruise with a wispy baldingness and various other prostheses, together with a good-ol’-boy twang and a Stetson borrowed from Slim Pickens’s bomb-riding army major in Kubrick’s Dr Strangelove. His prized possession is the battered old shovel his granddaddy used a century before, digging for black gold as a penniless young man in the lone star state. Digger likes to brandish this to make a point. Continue reading...
sources.title: Digger review – Tom Cruise’s loudmouth oil tycoon goes hard in Alejandro G Iñárritu’s eco-satire

克魯斯主演生態諷刺片影評

這是衛報影評人對新片《Digger》的評論。片中湯姆克魯斯（Tom Cruise）飾演一名口無遮攔的石油大亨，他一人不負責任的鑽探行為，引爆了一場全球危機。這部片出自奧斯卡得主導演伊納利圖（Alejandro González Iñárritu），但影評人形容全片顯得吃力，又有點過度自我陶醉。

—— 本則來自衛報 2026 年 9 月 30 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
